entities.name: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network to indicate that authentication of the network has failed.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for NAS messages.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Indicates the security header format applied to the NAS message.

entities.name: Authentication failure message type
entities.description: Identifies the message as AUTHENTICATION FAILURE.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Indicates the reason for the authentication failure.

entities.name: Authentication failure parameter
entities.description: Optional parameter providing additional authentication failure details.

entities.name: Authentication of network failed
entities.description: Condition where UE detects that network authentication has failed.

relations.description: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message contains the protocol discriminator IE.
AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message contains the security header type IE.
AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message contains the message type IE.
AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message contains the EMM cause IE.
AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message may contain the optional authentication failure parameter IE.
Authentication failure condition triggers the sending of AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
